how_to_rule: Write the target form you want into verdict for each row -- one of the alternatives, or anything else. Write the source string itself to keep the entry in its source form. Leave verdict empty on no row: an empty verdict is an unruled row and the batch will not proceed past it. verdict_note is yours and is not read by anything.
what_a_ruling_does: Each ruled row becomes a terms entry in reviews/FD-en-v2.decisions.json, which outranks the naming policy wherever the string appears in the document.
